description: This file defines functions and types for reading and opening boundary files, including path resolution, file validation, and error handling. It manages boundary file access with sync and async functions, external dependencies, and internal logic for path resolution.

methods.name: canUseBoundaryFileOpen
methods.description: Checks if the provided file system object supports necessary synchronous file operations.

methods.name: openBoundaryFileSync
methods.description: Synchronously opens a boundary file with path resolution and validation, returning success or failure result.

methods.name: matchBoundaryFileOpenFailure
methods.description: Handles different failure reasons when opening boundary files, executing corresponding handlers.

methods.name: openBoundaryFile
methods.description: Asynchronously opens a boundary file with path resolution, validation, and error handling.
